name: echo mushroom hd
description: Proposal, 60 cell lattice (8 px cells, the creature at 3x as in summon demon HD). A red spotted toadstool sprouts under the left hand, pops and lands, the eyes slide to it and the antenna pings; in four frames the mouth opens round, the mushroom hops up past the hand and goes in, a chomp with the eyes shut happy and a gulp; then the slits open round and the pupils dilate frame by frame, 6, 10, 12 and 14 cells across, until only a one cell white ring is left round each, in a visor band grown round the eyes like goggles, with one small white highlight high on the left of each eye, an open grin with a red tongue and rosy cheeks; for 1.2 s the pupils drift round a small loop a cell each way, the right eye a step behind, while the highlight stays put (so against the pupil it slides the opposite way) and the torso sways a cell each way on planted legs; then a sky of two blues rises from the horizon behind it (deep over light, three tone bands between) with two near and two far clouds, white lit tops over light blue bellies, drifting left at 400 and 800 ms a cell, the face tips back a row and the pupils roll up and keep drifting round the top of the eye for 3.2 s, before the sky sinks back, the pupils shrink to the slits and it rests with happy eyes; judge whether the huge black pupils read as delighted rather than scary, whether the band still reads as the visor, and whether it is still this creature.
